## sand-p01-v01 (1)
He / is-victorious / Śiva / alone / possessing-spanda / self-established / who / inner-face / makes-taste // sand-p01
l2: He alone — Śiva, possessing spanda, self-established — who makes the inner face taste.
l3: He alone conquers — Śiva, throbbing, self-established — who savors the inner face.
